أفتري (form VIII)
# أَفْتَرِي (ʔaftarī) /ʔaf.ta.riː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِفْتَرَى (iftarā)
# أَفْتَرِيَ (ʔaftariya) /ʔaf.ta.ri.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِفْتَرَى (iftarā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
